source_format_note: Editable PNG sources for the decoded 2bpp tile/map bytes. Each resource is a lossless PNG: tilesets are 4-colour indexed images (8x8 pixels per tile, row-major), tilemaps are 32x32 8-bit grayscale images whose pixel value is the raw tile index. tools/build.py derives the game bytes from these PNGs and verifies the pinned decoded/packed SHA-256 values. All HAL streams, including earlier unreferenced allocations, are retained for exact published SHA-256. This is a localization release-source snapshot, not a complete game disassembly.
editing_note: Edit source/graphics/*.png tile atlases without changing tile counts or image dimensions, or edit the readable full-page PNGs in source/pages/ and run tools/pages.py retile; then run tools/repack.py with a new --version. Avoid anti-aliasing, transparency and off-palette colours. Existing pointers are preserved; a grown resource is relocated into free expanded-ROM space and its loader patches are rewritten. Translation JSON and assets/ PNGs are reference material only.
asset_license_note: Original tool code uses MIT; game-derived resources and font-derived glyphs are not relicensed as MIT. See third-party notices.
page_note: source/pages/<id>.png are the human-readable pages: 23 tilemap pages, 21 bundle pages (tiles+map in one resource) and 4 tile-sheet pages. They are rendered from the tracked PNG sources; edit a page and run tools/pages.py retile to split it back, then tools/repack.py. Bundle cells that reference original-ROM tiles are drawn as a placeholder and stay read-only.
